newsitem.title: USA: SOUTHWEST AIR CUTS FARES TO MARK NEW ROUTE.
newsitem.headline: SOUTHWEST AIR CUTS FARES TO MARK NEW ROUTE.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said Tuesday it set $99 one-way fares for travel between Albuquerque, N.M., and Tampa Bay or Orlando, Fla., to mark the carrier's new nonstop service between them.
The new nonstop service begins September 7. The special $99 one-way fare must be purchased within one day of making reservations and by September 6.
The fare is valid only on nonstop flights between the markets and is good through November 20. No stayover is required, Southwest Airline said in a news release.
